name: Bunker by NosisTech
description: Offline, read-only MCP server that classifies public crypto addresses for public-key exposure and returns a step-by-step plan. It never signs or submits transactions, and it rejects seed phrases and private keys. External integration; off until you turn it on.
saferAlternatives: Pass only public addresses. Never send a seed phrase or private key; the server rejects those inputs and does not need them.
Treat the output as educational, not financial advice. Confirm each address on a block explorer and send a small test amount before moving funds.
Run the official local stdio server from the nosistech/nosis-bunker repository or the published release. Do not point a client at an untrusted copy.
